string-array.name: ric_resumenes
string-array.item: Covers the connection between the distribution company’s grid and the customer installation: service types, their location, metering and connection conditions.
Requirements for the panels that distribute and protect circuits: how they are built, where they go, how they are labelled and accessed.
How to size feeders and estimate an installation’s maximum demand from its loads, including the allowed voltage drop.
Permitted conductors and materials, their current capacity and identification, and raceway systems: conduits, trays, ladders and similar.
Measures that protect people from direct and indirect contact with live parts, and the installation from overcurrents and overvoltages.
Earthing systems and equipotential bonding: earthing arrangements, electrodes and how they are verified.
Conditions for supplying and protecting specific equipment such as motors, capacitors and transformers.
Installations that must keep working when the normal supply fails: emergency lighting, backup sources and their transfer.
On-site generation, grid-connected or not, such as solar PV or generator sets, and its connection and protection conditions.
Requirements for homes, offices and shops: circuits, outlets, protection and room conditions.
Rooms and applications with their own requirements, such as bathrooms, pools and other places with particular risks.
Installations in places with flammable gases, vapours or dusts: area classification and suitable equipment.
Substations and electrical rooms inside the customer installation: layout, working space, ventilation and safety.
Criteria for using energy efficiently in installations.
Infrastructure for charging electric vehicles: charging points, their supply and protection.
Scope to be defined after reviewing the official PDF.
Operation and maintenance of installations over their service life: inspections, records and responsibilities.
How installation projects are submitted to the SEC: documents, drawings, design calculations and the declaration.
Inspections and tests carried out before energizing an installation, and how they are recorded.
